data.one_liner: A Dart port of jBCrypt for hashing and checking passwords with a configurable work factor.
data.what_it_does: It encrypts passwords using BCrypt with a configurable work factor to increase off-line cracking costs. It also provides methods to verify plain passwords against hashed ones.
use_when: You need to securely hash passwords in a Dart application
You need to verify user-entered passwords against stored BCrypt hashes
avoid_when: You need general-purpose cryptographic hashing like SHA-256 or MD5
strengths: Simple API for hashing and checking passwords
weaknesses: No external dependencies listed but limited features beyond BCrypt
